scope: offline attribute-return statistics and bounded preservation checks; no UE execution

definitions.strict_explicit_ancestor_return: edited target value differs from source and occurs on selected source_position ancestry (including root/source)
definitions.chronological_edited_target_repeat: edited target value differs from source and occurs anywhere earlier in chronological history
definitions.other_branch_edited_target_repeat: chronological edited target repeat that is not a strict ancestor return
definitions.implicit_unedited_axis_reset: at a fork, an unedited target axis differs from chronological latest; inherited from selected source
definitions.event_unit: one (step, axis); a fork may reset several unedited axes

full_node_repeats.equality: formal canonical rendered state including sex and aspect

baseline_preservation.exact_start_node_check: same session id, node id and full saved state
baseline_preservation.parent_topology_check: source_position sequence for every corresponding session
